ASM — Das Spiel: original intro

Development preview of the complete original intro. Use the mouse to choose music and difficulty, then click through the logo and title screens; right click skips to loading. Canvas renders the HAM title image. The main adventure is the next milestone and is not included yet.

Controls

Use the mouse to choose music and difficulty; click to advance the intro. Choose Keyboard: Typing to enter text; switch back to Keyboard: Joystick to play. Gamepad and touch controls work in both modes. Escape leaves fullscreen.
